<!-- pr-reviewer: d9fd514b6142960a897b31c70806748dd5b1c28d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Reviewed locally in `.claude/worktrees/pr-3503-rev2`. No GitHub runner was used. The trial merge with `origin/main` (`8c6b77f94`) is clean. All results below ran on the trial-merge tree.

**What looks good**

- The kept-piece setting is one value, `PartKerf` (`crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs:108`). The kernel, the gouge law, the stamp, the project file, the page and MCP all read it.
- Both earlier blockers are fixed on this head. Each has a passing pin.
- The five conflict resolutions keep both sides. Main's `part-off-kerf-side-v1` salt survives (`crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs:147`). Main's `part_off_problem` and `plane_inside_model` refusal survives (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3053`). The branch's `PartKerf` items are added next to them (`crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs:160`, `:208`).
- The setting is not defaulted into the stamp. An op saved after #3452 keeps its program and its stamp (`crates/app/src/operation/params/turning.rs:159`).
- The refusal text names the kept side truthfully. `no_part_past_plane_for` names the side of the model and the setting that resolves it (`crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs:160`). The page labels map to the values correctly, and the right-to-left row reads "Cut-off piece  Chuck piece" (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/turning_page.rs:304`).
- Validation is at the command door and in the kernel and the verdict. A negative or non-finite back stock is refused (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs:1109`, `crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs:130`).
- No new `camcraft-*` dependency line. No process file, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `build.rs`, script, `.github`, `.cargo` or snapshot PNG changed. No `.nc`, `.cl`, golden or catalog file changes against current main. The PR body has the `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #3469`.

**Results merged with main**

Trial merge: clean, one local merge commit. Build on the trial tree:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test turning_part_kept` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test turning_part_kerf` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test lathe_part_off_kerf` | 9 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_part_kerf` | 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test part_off_saved_before_3452` | 2 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setup_align_lathe` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` (full) | 39 passed, 4 ignored, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib part_kerf` (from `crates/ui`) | 1 passed, 1523 filtered |
| `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The `example_catalog` count is 39 on current main. Main added the `3d/rough-finish` case since the body was written.

**The earlier findings**

1. Old centered-kerf cache. Closed. Main's salt at `crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs:147` is written for every Part op. `part_off_saved_before_3452` opens the recorded pre-#3452 project, reads Stale, refuses the post, regenerates and posts safely. It passed (2 tests).
2. Catalog pin. Closed. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:315` requires `G01 X0. Z12. F0.02`, and `examples/catalog/turning/cone-thread/cone-thread.nc:680` has it. The full suite passed.
3. Screenshots. Closed. The PR body links the before and after views from the fork's images-only branch. No image is in this branch.
4. Conflicts. Closed. The trial merge is clean. `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs` and `crates/app/tests/setup_align_lathe.rs` equal main. `crates/motion/src/turning/mod.rs` and `crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs` keep main's items and add the branch's. `crates/app/tests/lathe_part_off_kerf.rs` keeps both helpers. No refusal or safety rule is lost: a default part-off in an ambiguous setup is still refused before a move exists, and an explicit `Chuck` states the side.

**Targeted tests**

- Example catalog: the full `example_catalog` suite ran. 39 passed, 4 ignored. This covers the post and toolpath change.
- Light lane: not selected. The only light twins in the tree are for adaptive machining (`crates/motion/tests/adaptive_troch_parallel.rs`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/tests.rs`). This diff does not touch them.
- Heavy lanes: none run. This is a `P3` PR (#3558). No heavy step is required.

**Questions / notes**

- The site Part page does not list the two new rows. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-turning.md:248` has the settings table, and it has no "The part is" or "Back stock" row. This is not a blocker. A small follow-up issue can carry it.
- The doc comment on `PartKerf::flank` and the test helpers read "back stock"; the UI label is "Back stock". The words agree.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
